title: RunPod job output returned by the handler
description: Metadata-only recovery path; target under 32 KiB (policy max_runpod_result_manifest_bytes). Never contains audio, prompts, URLs or credentials. The gateway reconciles it against the completion callback; only one path may produce the billing event.

status.description: claim_rejected = the gateway refused the claim, no generation ran. completion_unconfirmed = audio uploaded but the callback did not get an answer; the gateway must reconcile from this manifest.
